'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Conrad Simmering DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Conrad Simmering]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ROPS
* '''Username:''' Maul12555
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
